payload.text:
]]>

I've added a Gain Control feature to allow manual volume amplification.

Key Updates:

  • Manual Gain Action: Added a "Gain" button to the main control panel. Clicking it opens a precise adjustment slider ranging from 0.1x (attenuation) up to 5.0x (amplification).
  • Selection-Aware: If you select a region with your mouse, the Gain multiplier will only be applied to that specific part. If no selection is active, it applies to the entire track.
  • Non-Destructive Workflow: Like other effects, manual gain supports Undo/Redo and can be reverted via the Reset button.
  • Visual feedback: The Gain panel features a high-contrast purple theme to distinguish it from the Gate and Normalization tools.

You can now amplify specific sections of your audio precisely by selecting them and applying the desired multiplier.
